title: ISO 14521:2026 — Gears — Calculation of load capacity of worm gears
locator: Official catalogue abstract and scope: cylindrical worm gear load ratings for wear, pitting, worm deflection, tooth breakage and temperature; validity conditions and exclusions
notes: Published in September 2026 and replaces ISO/TS 14521:2020. The calculation method has stated limits including tooth surface sliding velocity and contact ratio; the catalogue states that scuffing and other failure modes are not covered. It is not an assembled machine-tool rotary table acceptance specification. Full text is not archived.
